CVE-2026-110697.description: A flaw was found in Quay where the robot account listing function constructs a SQL LIKE pattern from user-controlled namespace names without escaping wildcard metacharacters. An attacker who creates a namespace containing an underscore character can match and retrieve robot accounts and their decrypted authentication tokens from other tenants' namespaces, leading to cross-tenant credential theft and unauthorized image operations.

posts.content: CVE-2026-120221: FRRouting bgpd (8.4+) HIGH vuln – double free when "bgp listen range" & SoO are configured on the same peer-group. Remote attackers can drop all BGP sessions. Avoid this config & monitor for patches. https://radar.offseq.com/threat/in-frrouting-84-and-later-bgpd-frees-the-same-memory-twice-when-dynamic-bgp-neighbors-disconnect-if-3c3036844388fa75 #OffSeq #BGP #Infosec

CVE-2026-120221.description: In FRRouting 8.4 and later, bgpd frees the same memory twice when dynamic BGP neighbors disconnect, if the peer-group used by a "bgp listen range" also has a Site-of-Origin configured ("neighbor PG soo"). Each dynamic neighbor shares the peer-group's SoO value instead of getting its own copy, but frees it as its own when the neighbor is deleted, which happens as soon as its connection closes. The first disconnect leaves the peer-group pointing at freed memory, and the second disconnect frees it again, causing bgpd to abort and drop all BGP sessions on the router. Any host whose address falls inside the listen range can trigger this by opening and closing two TCP connections to the BGP port, without sending any BGP message and without knowing the AS number, and can repeat it each time bgpd restarts. If the peer-group has a TCP-MD5 password, only hosts that know the password can trigger it. Two ordinary flaps of legitimate dynamic neighbors have the same effect. Between the two frees, displaying the configuration ("show running-config") or establishing a dynamic neighbor also reads the freed memory, which can crash bgpd after a single disconnect. Only configurations that combine a listen range with a SoO on the same peer-group are affected.

CVE-2026-6460.description: Type confusion in PostgreSQL allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via ALTER ... SET DATA TYPE primarily.  Other DDL attack routes exist, such as "ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN; ROLLBACK; ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN".  The system had inadequate tracking of typed values, and values were not self-identifying.  Stale values could appear in data dictionary entries, PL/pgSQL variables, and many other parts of the system.  PostgreSQL Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

Tested in the lab: CVE-2026-14227: Active API sessions retain permissions after downgrade

We verified that on RouterOS 7.23.3, an active API session is not invalidated when user permissions are reduced. The user can continue to execute commands with previous privileges as long as the session remains open.

The full report is reserved for dojo members for 30 days. Joining is free.

#MikroTik #RouterOS #infosec #CVE #CyberSecurity

Shared with @mikrotik

CVE-2026-14227.description: An API session‑management flaw in products with the MikroTik RouterOS API enabled are vulnerable to a Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability. This could allow active sessions to retain their previous permission set after inactivity timeouts or user‑group changes. As a result, an authenticated user whose permissions have been reduced may continue accessing information.

posts.content:
N-able N-central: la nuova catena zero-day 4EverAble2Shell è sfruttata da poche ore dopo il PoC del 12/11.

21 server con miner XMRig (Lupovis, Huntback); 19 avevano già Hotfix 2. La catena usa CVE-2026-90436 (Apache Axis) e una privilege escalation senza CVE: root senza login, se la Legacy API è attiva (watchTowr).

Da fare: disattivare la Legacy API, aggiornare Agent e Probe, cercare XMRig e nuovi cron/systemd. Nessun fix dedicato finora.

https://www.securityweek.com/hackers-exploit-new-n-central-zero-day-hours-after-poc-publication/

#Nable #infosec

CVE-2026-90436.description:
** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Deserialization of an inbound SOAP fault in Apache Axis 1.x allows unauthenticated remote class instantiation. When a SOAP <Fault> carries a <detail><exceptionName> element, Axis loads the named class and, if a String <data> element is also present, instantiates it through its String constructor before checking that it is an AxisFault. Loading alone runs the class's static initializer. With a suitable class on the application's classpath this leads to remote code execution. The fault is parsed while the engine resolves the target service, before any per-service handler chain runs, so authentication handlers configured on a service do not protect against it. This affects all Apache Axis 1.x versions through 1.4.



As Axis 1 has been EOL we recommend you migrate to a different SOAP engine, such as Apache Axis 2/Java. Alternatively you could use a build of Axis with the patch from https://github.com/apache/axis-axis1-java/commit/41f3b4e8d04e310ca81f86b92630ab2c11d608bd applied. The Apache Axis project does not expect to create an Axis 1.x release fixing this problem.

CVE-2026-119618.description:
Concurrent Execution using Shared Resource with Improper Synchronization vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 in assign_headers() can lead to RCE.

This issue affects Apache HTTP Server: from 2.4.55 through 2.4.70.
Affected releases of mod_h2 from GitHub: from 2.0.8 through 2.0.42.
